Love The Marriott Bonvoy Card, Hotels & Benefits!!!. After years as a Marriott Bonvoy member and Platinum Elite traveler, I can confidently say that the Marriott Bonvoy program is one of the best loyalty programs available.

What I appreciate most is the combination of outstanding hotel brands, exceptional customer service, and meaningful member benefits. Whether traveling for business, ministry, or family vacations, Marriott consistently delivers a quality experience that makes every stay enjoyable and rewarding.

One of the biggest compliments I can give the program is that despite having carried an American Express Platinum Card for many years, the Marriott Bonvoy card remains my primary card for most of our everyday purchases. The ability to earn valuable points on purchases we would be making anyway has allowed us to enjoy countless complimentary hotel stays, room upgrades, late checkouts, and other elite benefits that truly enhance our travel experiences.

As a Platinum Elite member, I particularly value the recognition, upgrades when available, bonus point earnings, and the consistency across Marriott’s extensive portfolio of properties. From weekend getaways to extended travel, Marriott has become our first choice time and time again.

If you travel regularly and want a loyalty program that genuinely rewards your business, I highly recommend Marriott Bonvoy. It has added tremendous value to our travels and has been one of the most rewarding credit card and loyalty program relationships we’ve ever had.

United States. My husband and I recently stayed at the Marriott hotel in Tempe, Arizona. We would first like to acknowledge that the hotel itself was beautiful and well-maintained. We enjoyed the amenities, including the restaurant, bar, and pool area, and initially had a very positive impression of the property.

Unfortunately, our experience took a very upsetting turn during our visit to the restaurant and bar. While my husband was interacting with the bartender, the employee made inappropriate and unwelcome advances toward him. According to my husband, the bartender suggested that he meet him in the restroom and made explicit sexual comments about what he wanted to do with him.

This behavior made my husband feel extremely uncomfortable, harassed, and unsafe. What should have been a relaxing and enjoyable stay quickly became a distressing experience. As a result, we decided to leave rather than continue our visit.

We believe that guests should be able to enjoy your facilities without being subjected to inappropriate or sexually suggestive behavior from hotel staff. We are bringing this matter to your attention so that it can be properly investigated and addressed to prevent similar incidents from occurring in the future.

We would appreciate a response regarding the actions that will be taken concerning this complaint. Thank you for your time and attention to this serious matter.
